name: Bartolomeo Fede
bioAdditions: The FamilySearch tree gives Bartolomeo's birth as about 1811 in Bisaccia, his marriage to Nunzianna Roberto as 10 Jul 1835, and his parents as Giuseppe Fede (c.1758 – 12 Jan 1829) and Angela Maria Loffa (1780 – after 1835) (S1, S2). Giuseppe's father was another Bartolomeo Fede, so the name ran in the family. Round 3 found Bartolomeo working as a pecoraio (shepherd) in 1867.
